params.caption: 🎮 Laid-off id Software devs launch new studio Hidden Horses A group of developers let go from id Software, the studio behind Doom, have teamed up to form Hidden Horses. Their first project is a first-person shooter called Danger Pay, which they are funding through Kickstarter. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 14:20 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC 👍 Like to support new indie studios · 💬 Would you back Danger Pay? #DangerPay #FPS #GamingNews
